episode_summary: In this episode, Kelsey Caputo discusses the transformative role of AI in real estate, particularly in luxury markets. She emphasizes the importance of using AI as a tool to enhance local expertise and build trust with clients. Kelsey also shares strategies for targeting high-net-worth buyers and the value of transparency in client relationships.
